No default alive value; expired/missing observation is no stub response
Existing success/error envelope reused; Unity error flow still needs validation
Internal cost-array decoder; calculation labels do not prove formulas; no costs deducted
Mercenary menu quote count*defines.mercenaryPrice is evidenced; negative/fractional/overflow rejection is internal safety policy, not original server error semantics
No production mounting, event activation, result generation, reward issuance or migration
_warCampaigns.queries[api] ownerId/observedAt/validUntil/complete/rows is internal storage; authoritative producers are not implemented
siege/getPairings and strategy/getStrategyWinLossRecords project complete persisted datasets only; absent data is not empty success
History totalCount=len(rows) is a full-dataset supported scope, not recovered original pagination; projections reject malformed rows atomically
